ambient_events: A brick drain riser climbs the north wall toward a faint grey coin of streetlight, impossibly far up.
The water here is oddly clean, diverted and settled — someone maintains this.
Bootscuffs and a coil of good rope say this landing is used, and often.
description: A dry brick landing at the foot of a drain riser — the storm shaft that climbs, up and up, into the back room of a certain repair shop on the surface. The Watch keep this stretch clean and quiet: it is the members' way down, out of the machine's sight the whole descent. The threshold itself lies east.
name: Terminus Landing
